// Scratch only (gap 1, CHAOS-3748): ask-dev's unranked cohort fixtures, from ACR's real encoder at
// the pin, with ACR_CONTEXT_FABRIC_VOCABULARY_LABELS_ENABLED on. Inputs: acr's contract example, and
// a real kiac capture of a pull request cohort (web tests/fixtures/ask-dev/captures).
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contextfabric"
)

const maxBytes = 65536

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func load(path string) contextfabric.InvestigationResult {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	must(err)
	var result contextfabric.InvestigationResult
	must(json.Unmarshal(raw, &result))
	return result
}

// unranked strips what the ranking pass writes, so nothing was ranked.
func unranked(result contextfabric.InvestigationResult, kind contextfabric.SubjectKind) contextfabric.InvestigationResult {
	result.RenderShapes = nil
	result.Cohort.Kind = kind
	for index := range result.Cohort.Members {
		member := &result.Cohort.Members[index]
		member.Subject.Kind = kind
		member.RankingComputed = false
		member.AttentionRank = 0
		member.Score = nil
		member.RankingBasis = nil
		member.DataCompleteness = ""
		member.Drivers = nil
		member.Outcome = ""
		member.MissingSignals = nil
	}
	result.Completeness = contextfabric.ComputeAnswerCompleteness(result)
	return result
}

func main() {
	out, capture := os.Args[1], os.Args[2]
	shapes := "contracts/examples/v1/context_fabric_investigation_result_render_shapes.v1.json"

	repositories := unranked(load(shapes), "repository")
	repositories.Cohort.Exclusions = []contextfabric.CohortExclusion{{
		Subject: contextfabric.SubjectRef{Kind: "repository", CanonicalID: "repository:full-chaos/archived", Label: "full-chaos/archived"},
		Reason:  "This repository is archived, so it is not a member.",
	}}

	zero := unranked(load(shapes), "pull_request")
	zero.Cohort.Members = []contextfabric.CohortMember{}
	zero.Cohort.Rationale = "No pull request reached from the subject the question names holds the status asked for now; that is a count of matches, not a statement about health."
	zero.Completeness = contextfabric.ComputeAnswerCompleteness(zero)

	cases := map[string]contextfabric.InvestigationResult{
		"unranked-repositories": repositories,
		"zero-match":            zero,
		"pull-requests":         load(capture),
		"work-items":            load("internal/api/testdata/work_item_fresh/normal.result.json"),
	}
	for name, result := range cases {
		served, tier := contextfabric.ServeVocabularyLabels(result, true, maxBytes)
		encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(served, "", "    ")
		must(err)
		must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, name+".json"), append(encoded, '\n'), 0o644))
		fmt.Printf("%-24s shape=%-18s kind=%-14s members=%-3d tier=%-8s labels=%d bytes=%d\n", name, served.Interpretation.Shape, served.Cohort.Kind, len(served.Cohort.Members), tier, len(served.VocabularyLabels), len(encoded))
	}
}
